summary: CRH America Finance filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for $4.2B of guaranteed notes across four series (5.375% 2032, 5.625% 2034, 5.750% 2037, 6.250% 2057), fully and unconditionally guaranteed by CRH plc. Concurrently, the issuer and guarantor launched cash tender offers for any and all Arcosa 4.375% 2029 and 6.875% 2032 notes and exchange offers for up to $1.0B of replacement guaranteed notes, alongside a consent solicitation. Proceeds partly fund the tenders; the offering is not conditioned on the concurrent offers. Watch tender participation and consent thresholds.
